```crystal
require "json"
require "http/client"
require "concurrent"
require "option_parser"
require "logger"
require "digest/md5"
require "file_utils"
require "yaml"
require "math"

module JAIDE

  class DataWorker

    property logger : Logger

    property config : Hash(String, YAML::Any)

    property queue : Channel(Tuple(String, String))

    property pool : Concurrent::FixedThreadPool

    property metrics : Hash(String, Float64)

    def initialize(config_path : String)
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @config = YAML.parse_file(config_path).as_h
      @queue = Channel(Tuple(String, String)).new(@config["queue_size"].as_i)
      @pool = Concurrent::FixedThreadPool.new(@config["num_threads"].as_i)
      @metrics = {"processed" => 0.0, "errors" => 0.0, "avg_time" => 0.0}
    end

    def start
      @logger.info("DataWorker starting with #{@config["num_threads"].as_i} threads")
      spawn_http_server
      spawn_processor
      spawn_metrics_reporter
      loop do
        sleep 1
      end
    end

    def spawn_http_server
      server = HTTP::Server.new do |context|
        if context.request.path == "/ingest"
          body = context.request.body.try &.gets_to_end || ""
          json_data = JSON.parse(body)
          ingest_data(json_data.as_h)
          context.response.status_code = 200
          context.response.content_type = "application/json"
          context.response.print({"status": "ingested"}.to_json)
        else
          context.response.status_code = 404
        end
      end

      address = @config["server"]["host"].as_s
      port = @config["server"]["port"].as_i
      server.bind_tcp address, port
      spawn { server.listen }
    end

    def ingest_data(data : Hash(String, JSON::Any))
      id = data["id"].as_s
      content = data["content"].as_s
      @queue.send({id, content})
    end

    def spawn_processor
      @config["num_threads"].as_i.times do
        spawn do
          loop do
            {id, content} = @queue.receive
            start_time = Time.monotonic
            begin
              processed = process_data(id, content)
              @metrics["processed"] += 1
            rescue ex
              @logger.error("Error processing #{id}: #{ex}")
              @metrics["errors"] += 1
            ensure
              duration = Time.monotonic - start_time
              @metrics["avg_time"] = (@metrics["avg_time"] * (@metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"] - 1) + duration.total_milliseconds.to_f) / (@metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"])
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def process_data(id : String, content : String) : String
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      embeds = embed_lorenz(tokens)
      normalized = normalize(embeds)
      hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(normalized.to_s)
      File.write("#{@config["output_dir"].as_s}/#{id}.json", {"hash": hash, "tokens": tokens, "embeds": embeds}.to_json)
      hash
    end

    def tokenize(content : String) : Array(Int32)
      content.chars.map { |c| c.ord.to_i32 % 75 }.to_a
    end

    def embed_lorenz(tokens : Array(Int32)) : Array(Float64)
      sigma, rho, beta = 10.0, 28.0, 8.0 / 3
      dt, steps = 0.01, 100
      x, y, z = 0.1, 1.0, 1.05
      trajectory = [] of Array(Float64)
      steps.times do
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dt * dx
        y += dt * dy
        z += dt * dz
        trajectory << [x, y, z]
      end
      embeds = [] of Float64
      tokens.each_with_index do |tid, t|
        normTid = tid.to_f / 75.0
        trajIdx = (t * 3) % (steps * 3)
        trajPt = trajectory[trajIdx // 3]
        basis = b_spline_basis(normTid, trajectory.map { |pt| pt[0] }, 3)
        (1..18432).each do |d|
          phase = 2 * Math::PI * d.to_f / 18432.0
          modX = trajPt[0] * Math.cos(phase) + trajPt[1] * Math.sin(phase)
          splineWt = 0.0
          basis.each_with_index { |b, g| splineWt += b * trajPt[2] }
          embeds << normTid * modX * splineWt
        end
      end
      embeds
    end

    def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int) : Array(Float64)
      nKnots = knots.size
      if degree == 0
        basis = Array(Float64).new(nKnots - 1, 0.0)
        (0...nKnots-1).each do |i|
          if knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]
            basis[i] = 1.0
          end
        end
        basis
      else
        basis = Array(Float64).new(nKnots - degree - 1, 0.0)
        sub_basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
        (0...basis.size).each do |i|
          left_denom = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
          leftNum = left_denom != 0 ? (x - knots[i]) / left_denom : 0.0
          right_denom = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
          rightNum = right_denom != 0 ? (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / right_denom : 0.0
          left_val = i < sub_basis.size ? sub_basis[i] : 0.0
          right_val = (i + 1) < sub_basis.size ? sub_basis[i + 1] : 0.0
          basis[i] = leftNum * left_val + rightNum * right_val
        end
        basis
      end
    end

    def normalize(embeds : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
      return embeds if embeds.empty?
      mean = embeds.sum / embeds.size.to_f
      variance = (embeds.map { |e| (e - mean)**2 }.sum / embeds.size.to_f)
      var = Math.sqrt(variance)
      var > 0 ? embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) / var } : embeds.map { |e| 0.0 }
    end

    def spawn_metrics_reporter
      spawn do
        loop do
          sleep 10
          @logger.info("Metrics: processed=#{@metrics["processed"]}, errors=#{@metrics["errors"]}, avg_time=#{@metrics["avg_time"]}ms")
        end
      end
    end

  end

end
```

```crystal
require "json"
require "http/server"
require "option_parser"
require "logger"
require "digest/md5"
require "file_utils"
require "yaml"
require "math"
require "mutex"

module JAIDE
  class DataWorker
    property logger : Logger
    property config : Hash(String, YAML::Any)
    property queue : Channel(Tuple(String, String))
    property metrics : Hash(String, Float64)
    property metrics_mutex : Mutex

    def initialize(config_path : String)
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @config = YAML.parse_file(config_path).as_h
      @queue = Channel(Tuple(String, String)).new(@config["queue_size"].as_i)
      @metrics = {"processed" => 0.0, "errors" => 0.0, "avg_time" => 0.0}
      @metrics_mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def start
      @logger.info("DataWorker starting with #{@config["num_threads"].as_i} threads")
      spawn_http_server
      spawn_processor
      spawn_metrics_reporter
      loop do
        sleep 1
      end
    end

    def spawn_http_server
      server = HTTP::Server.new do |context|
        begin
          if context.request.method == "POST" && context.request.path == "/ingest"
            body = context.request.body.try &.gets_to_end || ""
            json_data = JSON.parse(body)
            data_hash = json_data.as_h
            id = data_hash["id"]?.try &.as_s
            content = data_hash["content"]?.try &.as_s
            raise ArgumentError.new("invalid payload") unless id && content
            @queue.send({id, content})
            context.response.status_code = 200
            context.response.content_type = "application/json"
            context.response.print({"status": "ingested"}.to_json)
          else
            context.response.status_code = 404
          end
        rescue ex
          context.response.status_code = 400
          context.response.content_type = "application/json"
          context.response.print({"error": ex.message}.to_json)
        end
      end
      address = @config["server"]["host"].as_s
      port = @config["server"]["port"].as_i
      server.bind_tcp address, port
      spawn { server.listen }
    end

    def spawn_processor
      threads = @config["num_threads"].as_i
      threads.times do
        spawn do
          loop do
            id, content = @queue.receive
            start_time = Time.monotonic
            success = false
            begin
              process_data(id, content)
              success = true
            rescue ex
              @logger.error("Error processing #{id}: #{ex}")
            ensure
              duration = Time.monotonic - start_time
              duration_ms = duration.total_milliseconds.to_f
              @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
                prev_count = @metrics["processed"] + @metrics["errors"]
                if success
                  @metrics["processed"] += 1
                else
                  @metrics["errors"] += 1
                end
                new_count = prev_count + 1
                @metrics["avg_time"] = if new_count > 0
                  ((@metrics["avg_time"] * prev_count) + duration_ms) / new_count
                else
                  0.0
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    def process_data(id : String, content : String) : String
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      embeds = embed_lorenz(tokens)
      normalized = normalize(embeds)
      hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(normalized.to_s)
      out_dir = @config["output_dir"].as_s
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(out_dir)
      File.write("#{out_dir}/#{id}.json", {"hash": hash, "tokens": tokens, "embeds": embeds}.to_json)
      hash
    end

    def tokenize(content : String) : Array(Int32)
      content.chars.map { |c| c.ord.to_i32 % 75 }.to_a
    end

    def embed_lorenz(tokens : Array(Int32)) : Array(Float64)
      sigma = 10.0
      rho = 28.0
      beta = 8.0 / 3.0
      dt = 0.01
      steps = 100
      x = 0.1
      y = 1.0
      z = 1.05
      trajectory = [] of Array(Float64)
      steps.times do
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dt * dx
        y += dt * dy
        z += dt * dz
        trajectory << [x, y, z]
      end
      embeds = [] of Float64
      tokens.each_with_index do |tid, t|
        norm_tid = tid.to_f / 75.0
        traj_idx = (t * 3) % (steps * 3)
        traj_pt = trajectory[traj_idx / 3]
        basis = b_spline_basis(norm_tid, trajectory.map { |pt| pt[0] }, 3)
        (1..18432).each do |d|
          phase = 2.0 * Math::PI * d.to_f / 18432.0
          mod_x = traj_pt[0] * Math.cos(phase) + traj_pt[1] * Math.sin(phase)
          spline_wt = 0.0
          basis.each do |b|
            spline_wt += b * traj_pt[2]
          end
          embeds << norm_tid * mod_x * spline_wt
        end
      end
      embeds
    end

    def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int) : Array(Float64)
      n_knots = knots.size
      if degree == 0
        basis = Array(Float64).new(n_knots - 1, 0.0)
        (0...(n_knots - 1)).each do |i|
          if (knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]) || (i == n_knots - 2 && x == knots.last)
            basis[i] = 1.0
          end
        end
        return basis
      end
      basis = Array(Float64).new(n_knots - degree - 1, 0.0)
      sub = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
      (0...basis.size).each do |i|
        left_denom = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
        right_denom = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
        left_num = left_denom != 0.0 ? (x - knots[i]) / left_denom : 0.0
        right_num = right_denom != 0.0 ? (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / right_denom : 0.0
        left_val = i < sub.size ? sub[i] : 0.0
        right_val = (i + 1) < sub.size ? sub[i + 1] : 0.0
        basis[i] = left_num * left_val + right_num * right_val
      end
      basis
    end

    def normalize(embeds : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
      return embeds if embeds.empty?
      mean = embeds.sum / embeds.size.to_f
      variance = embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) ** 2 }.sum / embeds.size.to_f
      var = Math.sqrt(variance)
      if var > 0.0
        embeds.map { |e| (e - mean) / var }
      else
        embeds.map { |_e| 0.0 }
      end
    end

    def spawn_metrics_reporter
      spawn do
        loop do
          sleep 10
          snapshot = {} of String => Float64
          @metrics_mutex.synchronize do
            snapshot["processed"] = @metrics["processed"]
            snapshot["errors"] = @metrics["errors"]
            snapshot["avg_time"] = @metrics["avg_time"]
          end
          @logger.info("Metrics: processed=#{snapshot["processed"]}, errors=#{snapshot["errors"]}, avg_time=#{snapshot["avg_time"]}ms")
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```
